strategy_roster.name: Bullish Harami
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > open and close >= donchian_high_prev(high,1) and open <= donchian_low_prev(low,1)
strategy_roster.notes: Bullish Harami: small candle inside prior bearish candle, closing above prior high. StopLoss=2% documented.

strategy_roster.name: Bearish Abandoned Baby
strategy_roster.entry_long: low > donchian_high_prev(high,1) and close < open and close > sma(close,20)
strategy_roster.notes: Abandoned Baby reversal: gap up then bearish close above MA(20). Long on reversal confirmation. StopLoss=2% documented.

strategy_roster.name: Overnight Gap
strategy_roster.notes: Overnight gap up: open above prior high with bullish close. Fade gap on reversal. StopLoss=2% documented.

strategy_roster.name: Implied Volatility Spike
strategy_roster.notes: Volatility spike: ATR(14) expands above 1.5x its 20-bar average on bearish candle. Fade on contraction. Implied vol not directly observable; approximated by realized vol.

strategy_roster.name: Pairs Trading
strategy_roster.notes: Pairs trading proxy: long when price deviates >2 std below MA(20) with oversold RSI. Mean reversion to MA. StopLoss=2% documented.

strategy_roster.name: Volatility Risk Premium
strategy_roster.notes: VRP proxy: realized vol (std of 1-bar returns, 20) exceeds 1.5x its 50-bar mean on bearish candle. Short vol regime. No fixed stop documented.

strategy_roster.name: Bullish B's RSI Divergence
strategy_roster.notes: RSI divergence proxy: RSI oversold but price breaks prior 5-bar high. Long on momentum shift. StopLoss=2% documented.

strategy_roster.name: Volume Zone Oscillator
strategy_roster.notes: Volume zone oscillator proxy: volume ratio >2x with price above MA(20). Long on volume surge. StopLoss=2% documented.

strategy_roster.name: Volume-based Support & Resistance
strategy_roster.notes: Volume-confirmed breakout: volume >1.5x average with close above prior 20-bar high. StopLoss=2% documented.

strategy_roster.name: VWAP Stdev Bands
strategy_roster.notes: VWAP stdev bands proxy: long when price >2 std below MA(20) with oversold RSI. Mean reversion. StopLoss=2% documented.
